facts.text: Sir Phidipaldi agreed to help Quinn, owner of the Golden Egg, get back at Bentley, whom Quinn believes steals his ale each night, in exchange for 100 gold.
facts.ended_how: fulfilled: the party caught the real ale thief and Quinn accepted him as his thief

facts.text: Quinn offers Sir Phidipaldi 100 gold for helping him get back at Bentley, payable once the help is given.
facts.ended_how: used up: Quinn paid Phidipaldi, Trout and Uriah 33 gold each

facts.text: Plan agreed with Quinn: stage a fake shipment at the Golden Egg. Quinn brings up bottles, they fill them with water, and Sir Phidipaldi makes a big show of delivering ale to see what happens overnight.
facts.ended_how: no longer relevant: the thief was caught in the basement without the staged shipment

facts.text: Quinn says his good stock is gone by morning, with half the glasses empty or knocked over, and blames Bentley because the Clumsy Fox is so popular. Who or what is really taking Quinn's ale each night?
facts.ended_how: answered: the Clurichen Naggeneen was taking the ale
